unit.why: A brief anecdote, cited as an example in a homiletic list: for sixteen years the Seer of Lublin set aside an hour daily to thank God for the soul of the Berdichever rebbe.
unit.boundary_note: Short exemplum inside a numbered homiletic series ('ג)'); the trailing 'מענין קידוש לבנה' is the heading of the next section.

stories.summary_en: As long as R. Levi Yitzhak of Berdichev lived, sixteen years, the Seer of Lublin set aside an hour every day to praise God for sending such a great and holy soul into the world.
